prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A surreal, cinematic nighttime scene set on a deserted rural road, illuminated by the stark glow of car headlights cutting through the darkness. The composition is wide and atmospheric, with a strong sense of depth created by receding power lines and a corrugated metal fence running along the left side, reflecting the lights in distorted patterns. In the foreground, ethereal, ghostly shapes—resembling luminous, semi-transparent animals or spirits—drift across the road, their forms blurred and otherworldly, glowing with an eerie white light. On the right edge of the frame stands a solitary figure, seen from behind, dressed in white shorts, a sleeveless shirt, and a brimmed hat, hands on hips, gazing toward the spectral apparitions and the oncoming car. The overall color palette is monochromatic, dominated by deep blacks, silvery grays, and stark whites, evoking a classic black-and-white film noir aesthetic. The lighting is high-contrast, with sharp highlights and deep shadows, enhancing the mysterious and dreamlike mood. The camera angle is slightly low and wide, emphasizing the vastness of the night and the isolation of the scene, while the soft focus and subtle glow around the apparitions add a supernatural, almost hallucinatory quality to the image.
